preconditions.description: The input contains a single integer n such that 1 <= n <= 10^6.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum((n - k + 1) * math.factorial(n - k + 1) for k in range(1, n + 1)) + n) % 998244353
postconditions.description: The output is the number of distinct subarrays of the concatenated permutation sequence P modulo 998244353, where P is formed by concatenating all n! permutations of 1..n in lexicographic order. The count equals the sum over all possible lengths L from 1 to n*n! of the number of distinct subarrays of length L, which simplifies to the formula: sum_{k=1}^{n} (n - k + 1) * (n - k + 1)! + n, computed modulo 998244353.
The output is a non-negative integer strictly less than the modulus 998244353.
